title: Major Revisions
tagline: A deduction card game for scientists: find the flaw hidden in the manuscript before your review rounds run out.

slots.name: Question
slots.ask: What the study set out to answer, and what was planned.

slots.name: Method
slots.ask: How the study was designed and run.

slots.name: Sample
slots.ask: Who or what was studied, and who was lost.

slots.name: Measurement
slots.ask: How the outcomes and exposures were measured.

slots.name: Analysis
slots.ask: How the data were analysed and turned into a conclusion.

verdicts.name: Accept
verdicts.when: No flaw: every request was answered well.

verdicts.name: Minor revisions
verdicts.short: A gap in the reporting or the wording. The conclusion stands.
verdicts.when: Fix with clearer reporting or softer claims; no new analysis.

verdicts.name: Major revisions
verdicts.short: A real problem that the authors can still fix.
verdicts.when: Fix with new analyses, data the authors already hold, or a redone step.

verdicts.name: Reject
verdicts.short: A fatal flaw. Only a new study could answer the question.
verdicts.when: The data themselves are compromised; no reanalysis can rescue them.
